Zoho CRM Expert Needed – Sales Automation, Cadences & Workflow Optimization
Posted 3 days ago
Worldwide

Summary
Project Type: Initial setup with potential for ongoing collaboration
Experience Level: Expert
Hourly Budget: $20–$50/hour
Start Date: ASAP

About the Project

We're looking for an experienced Zoho CRM specialist to help our team maximize the platform's capabilities, streamline our sales processes, and build efficient, scalable workflows.

At Meridian Solutions, we work with technology vendors and enterprise IT decision-makers. Our goal is to establish Zoho as an effective tool for managing outreach, nurturing leads, tracking opportunities, and supporting our sales team's growth.

We're not just looking for someone to configure the platform. We want a knowledgeable partner who can guide our team, share best practices, and save us time figuring things out ourselves.

Scope of Work

We'll approach this project in phases, starting with our most immediate priority.

Phase 1: Email Cadences & Sales Outreach (Immediate Priority)

Our first goal is to establish effective, automated email cadences within Zoho CRM.

Responsibilities include:

Review our existing Zoho CRM environment and identify opportunities for improvement.

Configure automated email cadences for prospecting and follow-ups.

Set up enrollment criteria, triggers, timing, personalization, and exit conditions.

Implement lead segmentation and targeted outreach workflows.

Configure email tracking and engagement reporting.

Ensure cadences work effectively with our existing sales processes.

Train our team on how to create, manage, and optimize cadences independently.

Phase 2: Lead Management & Sales Pipeline Workflows

Once email cadences are established, we'll focus on building a more structured sales process.

Responsibilities include:

Design and implement workflows to move leads from the top of the funnel through qualification, opportunity management, and deal closure.

Establish clear lead stages, ownership, and follow-up processes.

Automate lead assignments, task creation, reminders, and status updates where appropriate.

Improve visibility into sales activities, opportunities, and pipeline performance.

Set up dashboards and reports to help our team monitor progress and identify bottlenecks.

Recommend improvements to make our sales process more efficient and scalable.

Phase 3: Ongoing Optimization & Team Enablement

We're interested in developing an ongoing relationship with a Zoho expert who can support our evolving priorities.

This may include:

Providing guidance on Zoho CRM features and best practices.

Helping troubleshoot issues and optimize existing workflows.

Identifying opportunities for additional automation.

Training our team to become more confident and self-sufficient with Zoho.

Supporting future CRM improvements as our business grows.

What We're Looking For

Proven expertise in Zoho CRM, particularly Cadences, workflow automation, and pipeline management.

Hands-on experience implementing Zoho for B2B sales organizations.

Strong understanding of lead management, sales funnels, and CRM best practices.

Ability to translate business requirements into practical CRM solutions.

Experience building reports, dashboards, and automated workflows.

Excellent English communication and training skills.

A proactive, consultative approach with the ability to recommend improvements rather than simply follow instructions.

What Success Looks Like

We're looking for someone who can help us achieve three key outcomes:

Save time: Reduce the manual effort involved in outreach, follow-ups, and sales tracking.

Build a scalable process: Establish clear workflows that help our team move leads from initial engagement through closed opportunities.

Empower our team: Teach us how to use Zoho effectively so we can manage everyday activities independently.

To Apply

Please share:

Your experience implementing Zoho CRM cadences and sales pipeline automation.

Examples of similar projects you've completed for B2B companies.

How you typically approach CRM implementation and team training.

Your estimated timeline for configuring our initial email cadences.

Your availability for ongoing support as our priorities evolve.

Important: We're looking for a hands-on Zoho expert who can both implement solutions and teach our team how to use them effectively. We're interested in building a long-term working relationship with the right person.
